messages.subject: C2
parts:
Any idea if C2 is an option under M2? Cai and Monroe (2014) developed a new model fit statistics for IRT called C2. I am wondering if the MIRT package has the option of C2 for model-data fit result?

Thanks,

Caihong

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: C2
parts:
Hi Caihong,

I'm aware of this statistic, but have not found the time to implement it (it's low priority given that it's only useful in certain special situations). It has been added to my TODO list as a long term goal, which will be added to the M2 function as M2(...., C2 = TRUE), or some flavour of that. Cheers.

Phil
